articles.title: A Space Rock Crashed Through a Roof — and It's Teaching Us How Life Began!
articles.summary: A meteorite smashed through a New Jersey home's roof in 2024. Scientists found it's a super rare type that holds salty clues from an ancient asteroid — like a time capsule from space!

articles.title: Tiny Bird Statues from the Ice Age Show That Ancient People Loved Birds Too!
articles.summary: Two bird figurines smaller than your thumbnail were found in a German cave. Carved from mammoth ivory 40,000 years ago, they show that even Ice Age artists paid close attention to birds.

articles.title: Think Cutting Out Sweet Foods Will Help You Eat Less Sugar? Science Says Not So Fast!
articles.summary: A six-month study found that eating less sweet food didn't change how much people liked sweetness or improve their health. It's sugar and calories that matter, not just sweet taste.
